notes.title: Glaive Updated
notes.notes:
Glaive has been updated!

-Performance and optimization improvements
-Improved lighting
-Menu instruction has been added on death
-Resolved a bug where the glaive would fly away when thrown at the boss as he walked to the stadium
-Enemies no longer spawn during and after the stadium walls open at the final event
-Updated restart menu graphics
-Removed "Reset Progress" option from start menu
